shared_elements: rectangular panel with a framing border of repeated motifs
small repeated units arranged in rows
justification: The only real correspondence is formal: both are rectangular panels whose field is bordered or filled with repeated small units (rosette-like sprays on one, glyph-like blocks on the other), and both keep to a single flat plane. In content they are entirely different: A shows a large standing bird-headed winged figure in profile holding objects amid floral sprays, while B shows an empty field dominated by a plain hatched disc flanked by small paired ovals, with no figures, animals or plants at all.
